IF
StatusRemoved(S_FOR_ThayanOrb_c9b5f985-466d-41d4-88fd-adfa999aaeb1, "FOR_THAYANCELLAR_TRAPFUEL", _, _)
AND
NOT DB_FOR_ThayanCellar_OrbFinished(1)
THEN
DB_FOR_ThayanCellar_OrbFinished(1);
PROC_FOR_ThayanCellar_OrbLeave();

PROC
PROC_GOB_TempleAccess_FinishedRotation(_Disk)
AND
DB_GOB_TempleAccess_Disk(_Disk)
AND
NOT QRY_GOB_TempleAccess_AllDisksCorrect()
THEN
Close(ITEMGUID_S_GOB_TempleAccess_Door_7241f91d-e34f-4615-b484-3b338c109d55);

IF
GameBookInterfaceClosed(S_TWN_BloodBankInventoryList_ccf165b7-1cf6-4111-a8a5-54526a50396d, _Player)
AND
IsInPartyWith(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, _Player, 1)
AND
GetDistanceTo(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255, _Player, _Dist)
AND
_Dist < 8.0
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("TWN_BloodBankInventoryList")
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD((DIALOGRESOURCE)TWN_InteractedWithBloodBankInventoryList_PAD_c770e379-31e0-f7d0-45a2-2f541a240e52, S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255);

IF
UseFinished(_Player, (ITEM)S_GLO_AnsurGhost_LegendOfAnsurBook_b0ecc3d5-85ad-48fa-bc47-988107507e6c, 1)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)WYR_AnsurGhost_Knows_AnsurQuest_81748d8c-8bac-427f-82b5-28db64bcff38)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)WYR_Balduran_Event_OpenDoor_99e8c929-4b71-3e03-2b43-6e7421896f7a)
THEN
StartVoiceBark((VOICEBARKRESOURCE)WYR_AnsurGhost_VB_ReadBook_c2c66ba3-5c0f-dd87-1575-97e1132f5010, _Player);
SetFlag((FLAG)WYR_AnsurGhost_Knows_AnsurQuest_81748d8c-8bac-427f-82b5-28db64bcff38);

QRY
QRY_CRIME_BlockRegisterCrime((CHARACTER)_Character, _CrimeType, (ITEM)S_WYR_Circus_DribblesBodyPart_Hand_dedf021f-478c-4a06-9150-f442e1cd2ecd, (CHARACTER)S_WYR_Circus_Merchant_60e4431d-dee5-4af4-a05e-65896ec64f2f, (INTEGER)_CrimeID)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_Character)
AND
QRY_WYR_Circus_IsHandStealingCrime(_CrimeType)
AND
CrimeGetNewID(_CrimeNewID)
THEN
DB_WYR_Circus_HandStealCrime((CHARACTER)_Character, _CrimeNewID);
PROC_CharacterRegisterCrime(_Character, "WYR_Circus_HandSteal", S_WYR_Circus_DribblesBodyPart_Hand_dedf021f-478c-4a06-9150-f442e1cd2ecd, S_WYR_Circus_Merchant_60e4431d-dee5-4af4-a05e-65896ec64f2f, _CrimeNewID);

PROC
PROC_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_ApplyStatusToChainedCharacters((CHARACTER)_Player, (STRING)_Status, (REAL)_Duration)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_PartyMember)
AND
_Player != _PartyMember
AND
InSamePartyGroup(_PartyMember, _Player, 1)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_PartyMember, _Status, _Duration, 1, S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_TalkingSkull_4bab8c98-ebde-45cf-9709-5da620fb7fe1);

IF
AddedTo(S_CRE_GithyankiEgg_999b6dd7-2901-4604-8280-1931a5217a94, _Player, _)
AND
NOT DB_Avatars((CHARACTER)S_Player_Laezel_58a69333-40bf-8358-1d17-fff240d7fb12)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam((CHARACTER)S_Player_Laezel_58a69333-40bf-8358-1d17-fff240d7fb12)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ORI_Laezel_State_CaringAboutGithEgg_b5a0ea04-d824-4e1a-bb90-b421acc6092b)
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)ORI_Laezel_State_CaringAboutGithEgg_b5a0ea04-d824-4e1a-bb90-b421acc6092b);
